body.name: Finite active-carrier tangent-rich proximal trial-network class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{L,\eta}\) is the class of tuples \((Q,P,G,\mathcal X,\mathcal U,\mathcal W,(\mathcal Z_e)_{e\in E})\) satisfying precisely the listed member assumptions, with proxy positivity and support-tangent requirements imposed through the nonempty common carriers \(J_x\).
